5. HOW SEALERS LOSE (114 losses): 90% conceded a capture before ply 40 (72% in their wins), only 46% got sealed

6. SEALER vs SEALER (46 games): the first capture wins 59%, the earlier seal 57%; having MORE stars at ply 40 wins 68%
   (keep the 5-6 start stars and protect them; the multiplier decides close games). Blue 24/46.
7. US (srik, 8 logged games): 62% wins, never sealed (seal-need 80-90 at plies 40-60), fortress/blob style. We lost to
   the wall-snipers (Eris, aryan) exactly as section 5 predicts.
